title: Convert 3D bodies in a PCB library to generic STEP
summary: Walks every footprint of the focused PCB library and replaces each extruded, cylinder or sphere 3D body model with a generic copy made by IPCB_Model.I_ReplicateToGeneric, with a dry-run count first.
phrasings: convert footprint 3D bodies to generic models
replace extruded 3D bodies in a PcbLib
loop over all footprints in a PCB library
change the model type of component bodies

commands.name: ConvertToStep
commands.description: Convert non-generic 3D bodies of the PcbLib to generic

commands.name: AddTestBody
commands.description: Add a cylinder 3D body to the current footprint (test setup)
